message_threads_context_check.name: message_threads_context_check
message_threads_context_check.value: ("message_threads"."kind" = 'general' and "message_threads"."job_id" is null) or ("message_threads"."kind" = 'job' and "message_threads"."job_id" is not null)

jobs_experience_range_check.name: jobs_experience_range_check
jobs_experience_range_check.value: ("jobs"."experience_min" is null or "jobs"."experience_min" >= 0) and ("jobs"."experience_max" is null or "jobs"."experience_max" >= "jobs"."experience_min")

outcomes_consent_check.name: outcomes_consent_check
outcomes_consent_check.value: ("outcomes"."visibility" = 'private' and "outcomes"."shared_at" is null) or ("outcomes"."visibility" = 'group' and "outcomes"."consent_granted_at" is not null and "outcomes"."shared_at" is not null)

ai_usage_events_token_counts_check.name: ai_usage_events_token_counts_check
ai_usage_events_token_counts_check.value: ("ai_usage_events"."prompt_tokens" is null or "ai_usage_events"."prompt_tokens" >= 0) and ("ai_usage_events"."completion_tokens" is null or "ai_usage_events"."completion_tokens" >= 0)
